resources.string: Use Wear OS with this phone

microG can pair a Wear OS watch with this phone. Notifications, media controls, and Wear apps talking to companion apps on the phone will use Bluetooth and the Wearable APIs.\n\nAccept to continue pairing. You can change notification mirroring and media control later in microG Settings.
Grant notification access so the watch can show phone alerts and control media
Pair the watch with this phone over Bluetooth, then enable the connection in the Wear OS companion. Terms of Service must be accepted when the companion asks.
